scope: Preserve the explicit media drop target and prevent a queued close from clearing a reopened media dialog target and list request

before.sourceState: Final nine cases executed on the unchanged preceding media controller before applying the production fix. The preceding controller hash matches release HEAD and revision 53.

fixtureSetup.reason: The first fixture omitted the generic project documents path and used the wrong HTTP adapter parameter shape, so no valid edit session started.
fixtureSetup.resolution: Set workspace paths, adapt pathValue and assert successful edit entry. Reran final tests before changing production code.

discovery.note: Confirmed wrong-block writes and additionally exposed queued close during paste-then-reopen; a ninth dedicated delayed-list regression was added before the final pre-fix run.

application.skipReason: Native archive interoperability and registry agreement require VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; prior b.4.0 native evidence retained.

testEnvironment: Real editor and media controllers joined in the event-capable DOM fixture; controlled focus/drop/cancel/close event timing. HTTP adapter uploads actual synthetic image/audio/video bytes to a temporary server, then the actual editor saves and reopens. Rebuild/registry/asset bytes checked independently.
limitations: The drop uses the target textarea selection; mouse-coordinate caret placement is not implemented.
DOM events and focus are simulated; native browser drag-and-drop, file pickers and XHR upload progress were not exercised.
The synthetic MP4 verifies import/reference/byte retention, not codec playback. Native windows, Rust and media decoding were not rerun.

cleanup.temporaryProjects: Existing test fixture teardown hooks completed; no persistent test workspace, service or media output created.
